subtitles.zh: 长鑫存储技术（CXMT）作为中国高科技产业的明珠，在上海科创板上市，成为当时中国第二大IPO。
subtitles.en: Changsin Memory Technology, or CXMT, one of the crown jewels of China's high-tech industry, debuts in Shanghai's Nasdaq-style star market in what is the second biggest IPO ever in China.

subtitles.zh: 十年前，合肥政府押注这家公司，而私人市场参与者却避之不及，挑战三星和SK海力士这样的巨头在当时看来风险极高。
subtitles.en: Ten years ago, the Hefei government made a big bet on the firm when private investors shundered, taking on giants like South Korea's Samsung and S.K. Heinex seemed like a risky bet then.

subtitles.zh: 创始人朱一明瞄准了标准内存芯片DRAM，这是计算机处理数据的关键硅元件。
subtitles.en: Founder Zhu Yiming set his sights on standard memory chips called DRAM, the Silicon Essential for Computers to Process Data.

subtitles.zh: 多年亏损后，公司终于实现历史性盈利，今年上半年净利润同比增长超过2200%。
subtitles.en: After years of losses, the company finally logged historic returns, pointing to a net income increase of more than 2,200% in the first half of this year.

subtitles.zh: 这一收益得益于数据中心需求的激增，推动芯片价格多次上涨。
subtitles.en: Driving that windfall is the glut in data center demand that's pushed up chip prices several times over.

subtitles.zh: 竞争对手削减DRAM产量，转向利润更高的HBM高带宽内存芯片。
subtitles.en: Competitors slashed DRAM production and shifted to build more lucrative high-bend-width memory on HBM chips.

subtitles.zh: CXMT正好填补了这一供应缺口，甚至吸引了苹果等巨头考虑采购其芯片。
subtitles.en: CXMT soaked right into that supply gap, even prompting bell-whippers like Apple to consider buying its chips.

subtitles.zh: 最初中国企业只是低端廉价产品生产者，但过去20年，它们在许多行业都展现了向上攀升、成为竞争力量的能力。
subtitles.en: Initially the Chinese were the kind of low-end cheaper product producer, but over the last 20 years, they've shown in so many industries that they can really move up and become competitive forces.

subtitles.zh: CXMT是自主可控战略的基石，这一点在上海世界人工智能大会上展露无遗，中国最新科技悉数亮相。
subtitles.en: CXMT is at the cornerstone of Presidency's self-sufficiency push, and nowhere is this clearer than here, as the world AI conference in Shanghai, where China's latest tech is on full display.
